senses.gloss:
सौगत m. (-तः)
 1. A Saugata, a heretic, an atheist.
 2. A Bauddha. E.
सुगत the supposed teacher of these doctrines, अण् aff.

सौगतिक m. (-कः)
 1. A Bauddha mendicant.
 2. The mendicant
Brāhman.
 3. Doubt, unbelief, scepticism.
 4. An atheist, an
unbeliever.
 n. (-कं) Atheism.
 E. सुयत the founder of the sect, ठक् aff.

सौगन्ध n. (-न्धं)
 1. A fragrant grass: see कत्तृण.
 2. Fragrance.
 f. (-न्धी)
Sweet-scented.
 E. सुगन्ध fragrant, अण् aff.

सौगन्धिक mfn. (-कः-का or -की-कं) Fragrant, odorous.
 n. (-कं)
 1. The white
water-lily, (Nymphæa lotus.)
 2. A fragrant grass: see कत्तृण. 3
A ruby.
 4. The blue lotus.
 m. (-कः)
 1. Sulphur.
 2. A dealer in
perfumes.
 E. सु pleasant, गन्ध smell, and ठक् added.

सौगन्ध्य n. (-न्ध्यं) Sweetness of odour, fragrance.
 E. सुगन्ध, and ष्यञ् aff.
